Production Glossary · 40/50 · audio

True peak

Definition

True peak is an estimate of maximum signal level between digital samples used to control inter-sample overload. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align audio decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

  • Loudness target
